$note: Render a saved PolyDoc template to a branded PDF and store it in Directus Files. Mirrors the n8n invoice-pdf-from-template template. Replace YOUR_TEMPLATE_ID with a template ID from the PolyDoc dashboard. Add your key as the POLYDOC_API_KEY env var (or set the operation's API Key).

flow.name: PolyDoc - PDF from template
flow.description: Render a saved template with data into a PDF and save it to Directus Files.
